definitions.explanation: A physical board where notices and announcements are posted.
An online platform where users can post and read messages.

notes:
{掲示板|けいじばん} combines ⟦{掲示|けいじ}→掲示：02838_keiji⟧ (posting/notice) + ⟦{板|ばん}→板：01792_ita⟧ (board).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {掲示板|けいじばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧ (to post on a bulletin board)
- {掲示板|けいじばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look at the bulletin board)
- ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掲示板|けいじばん} (internet forum)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{掲示|けいじ}→掲示：02838_keiji⟧ (notice, posting)
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{掲示板|けいじばん} (electronic bulletin board)
- BBS (ビービーエス - bulletin board system)

USAGE:
- Physical bulletin boards are common in schools, offices, and public buildings
- Online {掲示板|けいじばん} were very popular in Japan (e.g., 2⟦ちゃんねる→チャンネル：04469_channeru⟧)
